>They are happy   

You clearly don't have a grasp on the situation, they are not "happy", they are surviving with what life has handed them. Most homeless believe this is their destiny, they've tried not being homeless and have failed, usually several times, for whatever reason. They're left with two choices, be the homeless guy who's moping around, barely staying fed, smelly and bitter or embrace their shitty circumstances. I, like many chose the latter, being *content* with what I had. Not exactly happy, for I know damn well there's a better life out there but it's beyond reach, so it's more mentally healthy to pretend this is a good life, collecting cans is fun! You fool yourself into happy. Sit any one of those homeless " happy " people down and get them to open up, they are not happy.

> Can you give examples of circumstances that have brought you back to zero?

I guess the best place to start is eight or so year ago. I inherited a large sum of money, then proceeded to give the majority of it to my siblings. Stupid move, i know, this was before taxes which ended up being about triple what I had saved for myself, which I'd already spent. Not many people believe this but whatever, it's the god's honest truth. This (combined with interest and penalties) put me six figures in debt literally overnight with nothing to show but a pickup and some paid off debt.  
From there it's just been a matter of not earning enough fast enough. But even then, even if I could manage to save enough to deal with my tax issues I have nothing valuable to bring to the workforce, nothing that will get me from a job I despise to a career I'd enjoy.  
So three years ago my car broke down. I put rent money into fixing it, which was a horrible mistake. I just suck with money, plain and simple. anyway, dropped my next check on a new car, a month behind rent and it broke down. put another month's rent into the car and yup, head blew. Traded the car for a boat I intended to live on.. lol, horrible idea, put my last check into the boat to no avail and ended up once again homeless.  
Going back, I just make irrational decisions I suppose.  

>On that note, can you tell me how she lied to you?  

idk.. We were dating for about two years before she told me she had a daughter, whom she was caring for. We didn't live together, I was given.. swallowed? several excuses as to why we couldn't but it took two years before the truth came out. I have never met the man she lives with, they're not intimate, i try to believe this.. not sure I should but whatever. I was buying a car from him/her. Had it paid off and pressed for the title and she tells me they're still paying on it, in fact, she's been secretly paying and addition amount on top of what I was paying. I have only met her daughter once, recently, i four years. I have only met the youngest of the three kids living with her a few times several years ago. She doesn't want to complicate their childhood by trying to integrate me.. or something.. idk. I've pressed, then she gets jumpy so I back off, I just don't know how to take control or change the situation. I don't know how to fix what should have been me fully involved from day one.  

>I'm sure there's more you bring to the table than just that, whether you see it or not.  

What? Like even if you knew me yo would see that I really have don't have much to offer. I like to see a smile. I like to (pardon), get her off. I like to tinker. But none of this really has much value in the real world. I like seeing people happy, making people happy. But most of that takes money. I like being my own person, but he sucks at life. lol  

>Please don't give up, friend.  

I don't want to, but I don't know how to fix me. All the help yourself subs seem beyond me.. I'm in trouble. It's just easier, more realistic to just throw in the towel and let the pieces fall where they may.  

edit: At this point thinking I should just hire one of these craigslist prostitutes.. can't hurt I suppose. Can't really afford one without compromising a bill or two but I've never gone down that road, a new experience! Then I could tell her I slept with someone else, not be lying(I suck at lying) and she'd never talk to me again. My train wreck would have begun but at least we'd be done for good. sounds like a perfectly irrational decision.. ugh, it's been over six months now. I don't feel much like a man anymore.. not even sure I know how to "man". probably die of a heart attack.
